seoTitle: How to Add Google Maps in Elementor (API Setup)
metaDescription: Learn how to add the Google Maps widget in Elementor, generate a Google Maps API key, enable required APIs, and fix common map loading errors.
intro: A Google Maps widget that won't load or keeps asking for an API key is one of the most common Elementor issues, and it almost always comes down to how the API key was set up. This guide walks through adding the widget, generating and integrating the API key, and fixing common display errors.

steps.heading: Add the Google Maps widget in Elementor
steps.body: Drag the Google Maps widget onto your page from Elementor's widget panel and set the initial location you want displayed.

steps.heading: Create a Google Maps API key
steps.body: Go to the Google Cloud Console to generate an API key tied to your project, which is required for the map to load properly.

steps.heading: Enable the required APIs
steps.body: Make sure the Maps JavaScript API and Geocoding API are enabled in your Google Cloud project, since missing either can cause the map to fail.

steps.heading: Integrate the API key into Elementor
steps.body: Paste the generated API key into Elementor's Maps API settings so the widget can authenticate and load the map.

steps.heading: Fix common map display errors
steps.body: If the map shows a gray box or error message, check for billing not being enabled on the Google Cloud project or restrictions on the API key.

faq.question: Why does Elementor ask for a Google Maps API key?
faq.answer: Google requires an API key for map usage to authenticate requests and track usage, which is why the widget won't load without one.

faq.question: Is the Google Maps API free to use?
faq.answer: Google provides a monthly free usage credit, but you still need to enable billing on your Google Cloud account for the API key to function.

faq.question: What's the difference between the free and Pro Google Maps widget?
faq.answer: Elementor Free includes a basic Google Maps widget, while Elementor Pro may offer additional customization options for map styling and markers.

faq.question: Why is my map showing a gray box instead of loading?
faq.answer: This typically happens when billing isn't enabled on the Google Cloud project or the required Maps JavaScript API hasn't been activated.
